en_title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day Reportedly Cut a Scene With a Fan-Favorite Daredevil Character And It Might've Fixed a Plot Hole
cn_title: 《蜘蛛侠：崭新之日》删掉夜魔侠戏份
subtitle: 删减场景补上漏洞？
opus_summary: 据称《蜘蛛侠：崭新之日》删掉了Claire Temple的一段场景，可能解释Peter Parker为何在医院仍未戴面具，但目前尚不清楚她是否回归未来Marvel项目。

quality_review.review_notes: Independent bilingual self-review completed for coverage, attribution, uncertainty, numbers, dates, currency, units, names, media, and natural Chinese news style.

paragraphs.en: Spider-Man: Brand New Day spoilers are featured in the article below. You've been warned.
paragraphs.cn: 下文包含《蜘蛛侠：崭新之日》剧透，阅读前请注意。

paragraphs.en: Spider-Man: Brand New Day almost had even more MCU cameos, and one of them may have fixed a slight plot hole.
paragraphs.cn: 《蜘蛛侠：崭新之日》本来差点还有更多MCU客串，其中一人或许能修补一个小小的剧情漏洞。

paragraphs.en: At the end of Spider-Man: Brand New Day, our beloved wall-crawler jumps in front of a bullet for Jean Grey after The Punisher takes a shot at her. This heroic moment nearly kills him, but he's thankfully rushed to a hospital, with Jean Grey using her powers to keep him alive until doctors stabilize him. However, fans have raised a concern regarding the fact Peter is unmasked in his hospital room, as this would mean there are at least a handful of random people who know his secret identity.
paragraphs.cn: 在《蜘蛛侠：崭新之日》结尾，我们心爱的蜘蛛侠在The Punisher向琴·葛蕾开枪后，挡在她面前替她挨了一枪。这一英勇举动几乎要了他的命，但所幸他被紧急送往医院，琴·葛蕾则用能力维持他的生命，直到医生让他脱离危险。然而，影迷提出了一个疑问：Peter在病房里没有戴面具，这意味着至少有几个陌生人知道他的秘密身份。

paragraphs.en: Of course, it's just the nature of the situation, and Peter probably places some trust in the people saving his life. However, there was a cut scene that may have actually helped explain this. According to a post from @JuanEditz on X (who had accurately leaked some details about the film's marketing plans), Claire Temple had a small role in Brand New Day. Rosario Dawson previously confirmed that she reprised her Daredevil role in the film, but didn't reveal the specifics.
paragraphs.cn: 当然，事情发展到这个地步也情有可原，Peter或许会信任那些救他性命的人。不过，一段被删掉的场景或许确实能解释这一点。根据X用户@JuanEditz发布的一则帖子（他曾准确泄露过影片营销计划的一些细节），Claire Temple在《蜘蛛侠：崭新之日》中有一个小角色。Rosario Dawson此前已确认，她将在片中重演Daredevil一角，但没有透露具体细节。

paragraphs.en: there was also another scene cut where the doctors are ripping open his suit but leave his mask on
paragraphs.cn: 还有另一段被删掉的场景：医生撕开他的战衣，但让他继续戴着面具。

paragraphs.en: Now, the X user claims that in a deleted scene, doctors would've cut Peter out of his suit and left his mask on to protect his secret identity. He would've then woken up with his mask still on and then bumped into Claire in the hallway, who was examining an X-Ray. The two would've had a "cute" interaction, and that would've been the end of it. Juan noted that he wasn't sure if Claire was in the room when they cut Spidey's suit off, but speculated that it was certainly possible.
paragraphs.cn: 现在，这名X用户称，在一段删除场景中，医生本来会把Peter从战衣中剪出来，同时让他戴着面具以保护秘密身份。之后他会戴着面具醒来，并在走廊里遇到正在查看X光片的Claire。两人会有一段「可爱」的互动，场景就此结束。Juan表示，他不确定医生剪掉蜘蛛侠战衣时Claire是否在房间里，但推测确实有可能。

paragraphs.en: The scene likely would've fixed fan concerns regarding Peter being unmasked by strangers. Claire Temple also likely knows the importance of maintaining a secret identity, since she patched up Daredevil on multiple occasions and has experience with a sensitive matters like this one. As of right now, it's unclear whether Claire will return in a future Marvel project, such as Daredevil: Born Again Season 3.
paragraphs.cn: 这一场景或许能解决影迷对于Peter被陌生人看到未戴面具的担忧。Claire Temple或许也知道保持秘密身份的重要性，毕竟她曾多次为Daredevil处理伤势，也处理过这类敏感问题。目前尚不清楚Claire是否会在未来的Marvel项目（例如《夜魔侠：重生》第3季）中回归。

paragraphs.en: Nevertheless, none of this actually hurt the movie. Brand New Day just had the biggest domestic opening in history , dethroning Avengers: Endgame. It's also on track to score over $2 billion at the box office and is among some of the best-reviewed Marvel films in history .
paragraphs.cn: 不过，这些并没有真正伤害电影。《蜘蛛侠：崭新之日》刚创下历史最高北美首映票房，击败《Avengers: Endgame》。影片票房也有望超过20亿美元(约合人民币135亿元)，并跻身历史上口碑最佳的Marvel电影之列。
